steps.action:
# The Last Light

Old Maren had kept the light burning for thirty-one years. Every night, climb the stairs. Every night, trim the wick.

The storms never scared her. It was the silence between them that did.

On the night the radio crackled with news that automated systems would replace her by spring, she climbed the stairs anyway. Below, a fishing boat pushed through the dark water, riding her beam home.

She thought about the men on that boat. Probably didn't even know her name.

She trimmed the wick.

That was enough.
